# BPFusion build: eBPF objects and userspace tools.
#
#   make            # build everything into build/
#   make probes     # only the eBPF objects
#   make run-probe  # build + run the ingress-wake probe
#
# Requires: clang, libbpf, libelf, zlib, libcuda/nvcc for the executor.

BUILD    := build
ARCH     := $(shell uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/x86/;s/aarch64/arm64/')
BPF_CFLAGS := -O2 -g -target bpf -mcpu=v3 -D__TARGET_ARCH_$(ARCH) \
              -I/usr/include/$(shell uname -m)-linux-gnu -Ibpf/include \
              -Wall -Werror -Wno-missing-declarations -Wno-unused-value
CC       ?= cc
CFLAGS   ?= -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter
LDLIBS   := -lbpf -lelf -lz -lpthread

BPF_SRCS := $(wildcard bpf/*.bpf.c)
BPF_OBJS := $(patsubst bpf/%.bpf.c,$(BUILD)/%.bpf.o,$(BPF_SRCS))
TOOLS    := $(BUILD)/wake_probe $(BUILD)/client $(BUILD)/echo_udp \
            $(BUILD)/bpfusion_load $(BUILD)/perfcount

.PHONY: all probes tools executor clean run-probe run-executor

CUDA_HOME ?= /usr/local/cuda
NVCC      ?= $(CUDA_HOME)/bin/nvcc
SM_ARCH   ?= sm_120

all: probes tools executor

probes: $(BPF_OBJS)

tools: $(TOOLS)

executor: $(BUILD)/executor

$(BUILD)/%.bpf.o: bpf/%.bpf.c bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	clang $(BPF_CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BUILD)/wake_probe: tools/wake_probe/main.c | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

$(BUILD)/client: tools/client.c bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -Ibpf/include $< -o $@

$(BUILD)/echo_udp: tools/echo_udp.c | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@
$(BUILD)/bpfusion_load: tools/bpfusion_load.c bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

$(BUILD)/perfcount: tools/perfcount.c | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@

$(BUILD)/executor: executor/executor.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h \
                   executor/cuda_timer.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -Iexecutor -Ibpf/include \
		$< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)


run-executor: executor
	./$(BUILD)/executor $${N:-20000} $${WORK:-4} $${BATCH:-1}

$(BUILD):
	mkdir -p $(BUILD)

run-probe: all
	sudo ./$(BUILD)/wake_probe $(BUILD)/wake_probe.bpf.o 20000 50 1
	sudo ./$(BUILD)/wake_probe $(BUILD)/wake_probe.bpf.o 20000 50 0

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)

.PHONY: qwen
qwen: $(BUILD)/qwen

$(BUILD)/qwen: executor/qwen.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# Same device kernel, host dispatch once per request: a mechanism control.
.PHONY: qwen-control
qwen-control: $(BUILD)/qwen_host_launch

$(BUILD)/qwen_host_launch: executor/qwen.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_HOST_LAUNCH -Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# Device-launched HF graphs; Python captures only during bootstrap.
.PHONY: qwen-graph
qwen-graph: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# GPU-owned stock io_uring TCP; uses the same HF graph computation.
.PHONY: qwen-graph-uring
qwen-graph-uring: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu executor/io_uring_tcp.h bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_URING_NETWORK -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# Same concurrent GPU graph banks; host resumes once per retired request.
.PHONY: qwen-graph-control
qwen-graph-control: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_HOST_LAUNCH -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network_wait $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring: executor/qwen_graph.py | $(BUILD)
	ln -sf $(abspath executor/qwen_graph.py) $@

# Same resident GPU graphs with an epoll userspace TCP/HTTP control.
.PHONY: qwen-graph-user-network
qwen-graph-user-network: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu executor/userspace_tcp.h bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_USER_NETWORK -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# CPU-efficient network control; model graphs and device dispatcher are unchanged.
.PHONY: qwen-graph-user-network-wait
qwen-graph-user-network-wait: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network_wait.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network_wait

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network_wait.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu executor/userspace_tcp.h bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_USER_NETWORK -DBF_USER_NETWORK_WAIT -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# Upstream vLLM graphs with bootstrap-owned KV and GPU prefill/decode.
VLLM_PYTHON ?= python3
VLLM_CUDART = $(shell $(VLLM_PYTHON) -c 'import pathlib,torch; print(next(line.rsplit(" ",1)[-1] for line in pathlib.Path("/proc/self/maps").read_text().splitlines() if "/libcudart.so."+torch.version.cuda.split(".")[0] in line))')
# Default uses the qualified packed prefill and complete-prefix release policy.
# Named serial/grouped controls keep causal comparisons explicit.
VLLM_DEFAULT_NAMES := vllm_graph vllm_graph_user_network_wait vllm_graph_trace vllm_graph_user_network_wait_trace
VLLM_PADDED_NAMES := vllm_graph_padded vllm_graph_padded_user_network_wait vllm_graph_padded_trace vllm_graph_padded_user_network_wait_trace
VLLM_GROUPED_NAMES := vllm_graph_grouped vllm_graph_grouped_user_network_wait vllm_graph_grouped_trace vllm_graph_grouped_user_network_wait_trace
VLLM_CHAINED_NAMES := vllm_graph_chained vllm_graph_chained_user_network_wait vllm_graph_chained_trace vllm_graph_chained_user_network_wait_trace
VLLM_NAMES := $(VLLM_DEFAULT_NAMES) $(VLLM_PADDED_NAMES) $(VLLM_GROUPED_NAMES) $(VLLM_CHAINED_NAMES)

.PHONY: vllm-graph vllm-graph-user-network-wait vllm-graph-trace vllm-graph-padded vllm-graph-grouped vllm-graph-release
.PHONY: vllm-graph-chained
vllm-graph-chained: $(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(addsuffix .so,$(VLLM_CHAINED_NAMES))) $(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(VLLM_CHAINED_NAMES))
vllm-graph-release: vllm-graph vllm-graph-user-network-wait vllm-graph-trace vllm-graph-padded
vllm-graph-padded: $(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(addsuffix .so,$(VLLM_PADDED_NAMES))) $(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(VLLM_PADDED_NAMES))
vllm-graph-grouped: $(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(addsuffix .so,$(VLLM_GROUPED_NAMES))) $(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(VLLM_GROUPED_NAMES))
vllm-graph: $(BUILD)/vllm_graph.so $(BUILD)/vllm_graph
vllm-graph-user-network-wait: $(BUILD)/vllm_graph_user_network_wait.so $(BUILD)/vllm_graph_user_network_wait
vllm-graph-trace: $(BUILD)/vllm_graph_trace.so $(BUILD)/vllm_graph_trace $(BUILD)/vllm_graph_user_network_wait_trace.so $(BUILD)/vllm_graph_user_network_wait_trace

$(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(VLLM_NAMES)): executor/vllm_graph.py | $(BUILD)
	ln -sf $(abspath executor/vllm_graph.py) $@

$(addprefix $(BUILD)/,$(addsuffix .so,$(VLLM_NAMES))): $(BUILD)/%.so: executor/vllm_graph.cu executor/userspace_tcp.h bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) --cudart=none -dc -Xcompiler=-fPIC -Ibpf/include \
		$(if $(findstring user_network,$*),-DBF_USER_NETWORK -DBF_USER_NETWORK_WAIT) $(if $(findstring trace,$*),-DBF_TRACE) $(if $(filter $*,$(VLLM_DEFAULT_NAMES) $(VLLM_PADDED_NAMES) $(VLLM_CHAINED_NAMES)),-DBF_PAD_PREFILL) $(if $(filter $*,$(VLLM_DEFAULT_NAMES) $(VLLM_CHAINED_NAMES)),-DBF_PREFIX_RELEASE) $(if $(filter $*,$(VLLM_CHAINED_NAMES)),-DBF_CHAINED_DISPATCH) $< -o $@.o
	$(NVCC) -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -dlink -Xcompiler=-fPIC $@.o -o $@.dlink.o
	$(CXX) -shared -Wl,-z,defs $@.o $@.dlink.o $(VLLM_CUDART) -Wl,-rpath,$(dir $(VLLM_CUDART)) -o $@ $(LDLIBS)
production_sources.executor/qwen_graph.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Capture HF decoder graphs at bootstrap; native GPU dispatch owns requests."""
import ctypes
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from transformers import AutoConfig,AutoModelForCausalLM
from transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2 import Qwen2RotaryEmbedding
from transformers.cache_utils import Cache,DynamicLayer
from transformers.masking_utils import create_causal_mask


class SharedLayer(DynamicLayer):
    """A graph owns fixed offsets; GPU copies append into the shared KV buffers."""
    def __init__(self,key,value,pos):
        super().__init__()
        self.storage_key,self.storage_value=key,value
        self.keys,self.values=key[:,:,:pos],value[:,:,:pos]
        self.is_initialized=True

    def update(self,key_states,value_states,*args,**kwargs):
        pos=self.keys.shape[-2];end=pos+key_states.shape[-2]
        self.storage_key[:,:,pos:end].copy_(key_states)
        self.storage_value[:,:,pos:end].copy_(value_states)
        self.keys,self.values=self.storage_key[:,:,:end],self.storage_value[:,:,:end]
        return self.keys,self.values


def load_model(path):
    if not Path(path).is_file() and not str(path).endswith('.bin'):
        return AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(path,dtype=torch.float16,attn_implementation='eager').to('cuda').eval()
    with open(path,'rb') as f:header=struct.unpack('<6I2f',f.read(32))
    config=AutoConfig.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct')
    dimensions=(config.hidden_size,config.intermediate_size,config.num_hidden_layers,config.num_attention_heads,config.num_key_value_heads,config.vocab_size)
    if tuple(header[:6])!=dimensions or np.float32(config.rms_norm_eps)!=header[6] or config.rope_parameters['rope_theta']!=header[7]:
        raise ValueError('weight/config layout mismatch')
    with torch.device('meta'):
        model=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config(config,dtype=torch.float16,attn_implementation='eager')
    model.to_empty(device='cuda')
    # to_empty leaves buffers uninitialized; rebuild the real CPU RoPE initializer.
    model.model.rotary_emb=Qwen2RotaryEmbedding(config).to('cuda')
    weights=np.memmap(path,dtype=np.float16,offset=32,mode='r');cursor=0
    def copy(parameter):
        nonlocal cursor
        n=parameter.numel()
        data=np.array(weights[cursor:cursor+n]).reshape(tuple(parameter.shape))
        parameter.copy_(torch.from_numpy(data).to('cuda'));cursor+=n
    copy(model.model.embed_tokens.weight)
    for layer in model.model.layers:
        copy(layer.input_layernorm.weight)
        for projection in [layer.self_attn.q_proj,layer.self_attn.k_proj,layer.self_attn.v_proj]:
            copy(projection.weight);copy(projection.bias)
        copy(layer.self_attn.o_proj.weight);copy(layer.post_attention_layernorm.weight)
        for projection in [layer.mlp.gate_proj,layer.mlp.up_proj,layer.mlp.down_proj]:copy(projection.weight)
    copy(model.model.norm.weight)
    if cursor!=weights.size:raise ValueError('weight layout mismatch')
    model.tie_weights()
    return model.eval()


def main():
    if len(sys.argv)<2:raise SystemExit('usage: qwen_graph.py WEIGHTS.bin|HF_MODEL [seconds]')
    seconds=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 60
    entry=Path(sys.argv[0])
    library=entry.with_suffix('.so') if entry.name in ('qwen_graph','qwen_graph_host_launch','qwen_graph_user_network','qwen_graph_user_network_wait','qwen_graph_uring') else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'build/qwen_graph.so'
    lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(library))
    lib.max_tokens.restype=ctypes.c_uint
    lib.max_requests.restype=ctypes.c_uint
    limit=lib.max_tokens();context=2*limit;banks=[]
    with torch.no_grad():
        model=load_model(sys.argv[1]);config=model.config
        print(f'capturing model={config._name_or_path} type={config.model_type} fp16 eager',flush=True)
        from transformers.models.qwen2 import modeling_qwen2 as qwen2
        qwen2.apply_rotary_pos_emb=torch.compile(qwen2.apply_rotary_pos_emb,options={"emulate_precision_casts":True})
        @torch.compile(options={"emulate_precision_casts":True})
        def norm_finish(hidden_states,variance,weight,eps,input_dtype):
            return weight*(hidden_states*torch.rsqrt(variance+eps)).to(input_dtype)
        def norm_forward(self,hidden_states):
            input_dtype=hidden_states.dtype
            hidden_states=hidden_states.to(torch.float32)
            variance=hidden_states.pow(2).mean(-1,keepdim=True)
            return norm_finish(hidden_states,variance,self.weight,self.variance_epsilon,input_dtype)
        qwen2.Qwen2RMSNorm.forward=norm_forward
        dim=config.hidden_size//config.num_attention_heads
        for bank in range(lib.max_requests()):
            keys=[torch.zeros((1,config.num_key_value_heads,context,dim),dtype=torch.float16,device='cuda') for _ in model.model.layers]
            values=[torch.zeros_like(k) for k in keys]
            tokens=torch.zeros(limit,dtype=torch.long,device='cuda')
            graphs=[None];selected=[None];keepers=[]
            stream=torch.cuda.Stream();stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
            for index in range(1,limit+context-1):
                count=index if index<=limit else 1
                pos=0 if index<=limit else index-limit
                inp=tokens[:count].reshape(1,count)
                positions=torch.arange(pos,pos+count,device='cuda').reshape(1,count)
                def cache():
                    return Cache(layers=[SharedLayer(k,v,pos) for k,v in zip(keys,values)])
                def forward():
                    return model(inp,position_ids=positions,attention_mask=mask,past_key_values=cache(),use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1)
                mask=create_causal_mask(config=config,inputs_embeds=model.model.embed_tokens(inp),attention_mask=None,past_key_values=cache(),position_ids=positions)
                stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
                with torch.cuda.stream(stream):warm=forward()
                torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream);torch.cuda.synchronize()
                graph=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(keep_graph=True)
                with torch.cuda.graph(graph,stream=stream):
                    output=forward()
                    token=output.logits[:,-1,:].argmax(-1)
                graphs.append(graph);selected.append(token);keepers.append((output,positions,mask,inp))
                if index%32==0:print(f'captured bank {bank} model graph {index}/{limit+context-2}',flush=True)
            torch.cuda.synchronize()
            banks.append((tokens,graphs,selected,keepers))
        lib.serve.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulonglong),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulonglong),ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulonglong),ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_uint]
        lib.serve.restype=ctypes.c_int
        count=len(graphs);size=count*len(banks)
        raw=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(*(g.raw_cuda_graph() if g else 0 for _,graphs,_,_ in banks for g in graphs))
        out=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(*(t.data_ptr() if t is not None else 0 for _,_,selected,_ in banks for t in selected))
        inputs=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*len(banks))(*(tokens.data_ptr() for tokens,_,_,_ in banks))
        status=lib.serve(raw,out,count,inputs,config.vocab_size,config.num_hidden_layers,config.hidden_size,seconds)
        if status:raise SystemExit(status)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

prototype_versions: mixed=original general header; lifecycle/alllong=HTTP-reject DONE guard; production=shared types/tags and guarded model quiescence
